observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black Nikon DSLR camera with 'Nikon' and 'D800' clearly visible on the body. The lens is attached, labeled 'NIKKOR 85mm 1:1.8G AF-S'. The camera has a red accent on the grip.
Photo 1: Top-down view showing the camera's top panel with 'Nikon' and 'D800' visible. The lens has 'NIKKOR 85mm 1:1.8G AF-S' and 'AF-S NIKKOR 85mm 1:1.8G' engraved. A hand holds the camera.
Photo 2: Rear view showing the LCD screen, rear controls, and lens. The screen is off. The camera has a textured grip and a black strap attached. The lens is visible with its front element.
All photos show the camera on a white plastic bag with 'McSteve' branding, suggesting a retail or resale environment.
The camera appears to be a used Nikon D800 with an 85mm f/1.8 AF-S Nikkor lens.

risks.risk: Camera may not be functional (e.g., shutter failure, sensor damage, or software issues)
risks.proof: A video clip showing the camera powering on, navigating menus, taking a photo, and displaying the image on the screen.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal damage or fungus not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens front element and rear element, or a video showing the lens being rotated and examined for scratches or haze.

risks.risk: Camera may have high shutter count or sensor issues not visible remotely
risks.proof: Photo of the shutter count display (if accessible) or a video showing the camera's shutter count being checked.

risks.risk: Camera may have water damage or internal corrosion
risks.proof: Photo of the camera's interior (if opened) or a video showing the camera being powered on and used without water exposure.

proof_requests: Video showing the camera powering on, navigating menus, and taking a photo with the screen active.
Close-up photo or video of the lens front and rear elements to check for scratches or fungus.
Photo of the shutter count display or a video showing the shutter count being checked.
Photo or video of the camera being used without water exposure.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
